description:
As a build engineer, you have a directory at /home/user/project/artifacts which contains various ZIP files generated by different builds. Your task is to identify all files in that directory with the .zip extension, and move them to a new directory called /home/user/project/archived_zips for long-term storage. Additionally, for verification, you need to generate a log file at /home/user/project/zip_move.log. This log must contain the names (not full paths) of all ZIP files that were moved, one per line, in lexicographical (alphabetical) order. For example, if you moved files foo.zip and bar.zip, your log file would look like: 
bar.zip
foo.zip
Do not include any other file types in the operation or the log. Make sure the archived_zips directory only contains the ZIP files after the operation.
